subject: How to keep the original tiplab order of a tree

messages.author: 5d59a1aea8fe2f82
messages.subject: How to keep the original tiplab order of a tree
parts:
Hi all:

    I am using ggtree to import tree from file (attached file test.tree), I want to keep the original tip lab order like in figure 1, however, ggtree reordered the nodes (figure 2), here is my code:

tree.test<-read.tree(file="/path/to/test.tree")
ggtree(tree.test, branch.length ='none',yscale = "none") + 
  geom_nodelab(aes(x=branch, color=branch), size=3,  vjust=-0.5)+ 
  geom_nodepoint(color="#b5e521", alpha=1/4, size=10) +
  geom_tiplab() + xlim(0,8)


  Best wishes!

Lily

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: How to keep the original tiplab order of a tree
parts:
In current release version (1.10.x), ggtree use postorder to reorder the tree. In devel branch, this reorder process was removed.

Maybe you can refer to <https://github.com/GuangchuangYu/ggtree/issues/157>.
